newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus shares up on valuations.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus shares up on valuations.

text.p: Shares in Canal Plus rose on Wednesday on its valuation of merger partner Nethold's pay TV assets at between 8.9 billion and 10.35 billion francs and Italian pay TV Telepiu at two billion francs, brokers said.
A broker said the valuations, given in a report prepared by Canal Plus for the annual general meeting on March 28, were encouraging for investors ahead of the Canal Plus-Nethold merger on April 15.
Canal Plus shares were up 2.39 percent at 1,157 francs at 1140 GMT.
